tokenizer_sweep.head: 25cf4798202c41dda4b5413052f5efc6ebbbbf2a
tokenizer_sweep.evidence: Dedicated bpe-vocab-sweep check passed at the exact head. TOK-37 already enforces duplicate training, serialized byte identity, strict round-trip/UNK checks, fertility, parameter-matched model probes and BPB-based selection, but its DATA-10 mechanics corpus is stale for TOK-111.

corpus_adjudication.reason: Canonical registry contains zero candidate sources and zero model-training-allowed sources; DATA-10 is explicitly BLOCKED_UNREGISTERED.
Manifest records external_training_eligible_sources=0 and contains_external_training_data=false; all UK/EN/code source mass is project-authored.
Rada Ukrainian source and Standard Ebooks English source are marked APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING, but the artifact authority says CANDIDATE_DISCOVERY_AND_RIGHTS_REVIEW_NOT_CANONICAL_CORPUS_APPROVAL.
Real code snapshots exist, but source rights remain REVIEW_REQUIRED and the artifact authority is discovery/mechanical pilot, not D03 training approval.

The new live head adds only configs/data/corpus_v02.json. No V0.2 build manifest, retained/reconstructable fitted corpus, held-out corpus, shard hashes, or successful corpus build evidence is present at this head. Its tokenizer.vocab_size=512 is a corpus-config input and must not be mistaken for model-informed tokenizer evidence.

execution.reason: Starting TOK-37 on DATA-10 or DATA-25 would directly violate the TOK-111 requirement to rerun on the newest real-source-backed corpus. Starting on DATA-101 V0.2 before a built corpus manifest exists would fabricate corpus evidence.

retest_conditions: DATA-101 V0.2 or a successor must produce a deterministic corpus manifest with immutable corpus identity and retained or exactly reconstructable source bytes.
The manifest must prove training-eligible provenance for every fitted external source and must not promote REVIEW_REQUIRED code sources by repository presence alone.
Train and held-out partitions must each contain nonzero UK, EN and code material with zero content overlap and benchmark/test material excluded from tokenizer fitting.
The corpus identity must remain unchanged for the full tokenizer sweep; any identity change invalidates all tokenizer artifacts and model probes and forces a full retest.
The exact D08 linux-x86_64-tokenizer-experiment environment must be active: CPython 3.11.16 and tokenizers 0.23.1 under the pinned profile/locks.
Only after those gates pass may TOK-37 be adapted at the corpus-binding/diagnostic seams; the ByteLevel BPE trainer itself remains the incumbent and must not be replaced.

A provisional tokenizer selection requires parameter-matched byte-control plus Pareto BPE model probes on the real held-out corpus and an aggregate/per-domain BPB decision; compression alone is insufficient.
No tokenizer freeze is permitted while corpus V1/V0.2 remains unstable.

truth_boundary.claim: TOK-111 reconstructed and preserved the strongest valid incumbent path but did not execute a scientifically invalid sweep. No real-corpus tokenizer winner is claimed.
